title: Trade-Xp
tagline: A socio-finance dapp which enables users to trade while interacting with other users
description: This project combines a DEX for the exchange of cryptocurrencies a database containing the history of trades for effective trade analysis and trend prediction, and social features, including the ability to follow users, post content, and chat to give users the best possible trading experience and help them build their reputation as traders.
how_its_made: This project uses polybase to store the history of trades, push protocol to send trading signals to subscribed users, and NFT.storage to hold the post's contents, it uses uniswap as the DEX, using chainlink for automated stop loss and take profit and moralis API for getting users token balance. It is built using react.js and the smart contract is written in solidity.
